body.name: Bounded torus mechanism and decoder example
body.construction: Fix an empty DAG, product observational density one, \(q_i^0=1\), and \(q_i^1(t)=Z_i^{-1}\exp\{b_i\gamma_m(t)\}\) with distinct \(0<b_i<1\). For \(|\delta|<1/2\), let \(f_\delta(x)=(x_1+\delta\sin x_2,x_2,\ldots,x_n)\pmod{2\pi}\), whose inverse is \(f_\delta^{-1}(y)=(y_1-\delta\sin y_2,y_2,\ldots,y_n)\) and whose Jacobian determinant is one. Set \(\theta_\delta=(G_\varnothing,p_\delta,q_\delta,f_\delta)\).
